Name: Abigail Lewd Dialogue - Content Patcher Version
Author: Jester335
Description:
This is a conversion of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2883823]supervortex2004[/url]'s '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1542]Abigail Lewd Dialogue[/url]' mod converted to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] instead of having to replace the .xnb files.

Vortex compatible.

The dialogue content has not been altered in any way from the original.

Incompatible with any other dialogue modifications for Abigail.
